mapper.sql: select id, name_cn, name_vn, name_en, abbreviation, level, category, province, address, core_responsibilities, approval_items::text as approval_items, one_stop_services, contact_phone, email, website, working_hours, notes, created_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag from crm_government_agency
mapper.insert: insert into crm_government_agency ( id, name_cn, name_vn, name_en, abbreviation, level, category, province, address, core_responsibilities, approval_items, one_stop_services, contact_phone, email, website, working_hours, notes, created_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag ) values ( #{id}, #{nameCn}, #{nameVn}, #{nameEn}, COALESCE(#{abbreviation}, ''), #{level}, #{category}, #{province}, #{address}, COALESCE(#{coreResponsibilities}, ''), CAST(#{approvalItems, typeHandler=com.ruoyi.crm.handler.JsonbStringListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), #{oneStopServices}, #{contactPhone}, #{email}, #{website}, #{workingHours}, #{notes}, #{createdAt}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime}, COALESCE(#{delFlag}, '0') )
mapper.update: update crm_government_agency set name_cn = #{nameCn}, name_vn = #{nameVn}, name_en = #{nameEn}, abbreviation = COALESCE(#{abbreviation}, ''), level = #{level}, category = #{category}, province = #{province}, address = #{address}, core_responsibilities = COALESCE(#{coreResponsibilities}, ''), approval_items = CAST(#{approvalItems, typeHandler=com.ruoyi.crm.handler.JsonbStringListTypeHandler} AS jsonb), one_stop_services = #{oneStopServices}, contact_phone = #{contactPhone}, email = #{email}, website = #{website}, working_hours = #{workingHours}, notes = #{notes}, created_at = #{createdAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update crm_government_agency set del_flag = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
